description: Publish one HTML document (report, dashboard, Claude-style artifact) as index.html and deploy. Omit project_id to create a project. Hosted MCP cannot read local files — pass the HTML string (read the file first). Returns url, project_id, and deployment. Poll get_deployment_status until live or failed. For multi-file sites use the upload + deploy loop instead. Re-call with the same project_id to replace the live page.

force.description: If true, publish even when quality checks would block. Optional; default false.

html.description: Full HTML document to publish as /index.html. If you have a local file, read it and pass the contents here.

project_id.description: Hosting project UUID from create_project or list_projects.

title.description: Project display name when creating a project. Optional; defaults to artifact.

name: publish_html
title: Publish HTML
